result.text:
Incident response team, we have a critical operational post-mortem and mitigation plan for the Kafka cluster partition leader rebalance failure during yesterday’s traffic surge.

First, examine `config/server.properties` to confirm that `auto-leader-rebalance-enable` is set to `true` and verify that `leader-imbalance-per-broker-percentage` is configured to 1 percent. Next, review `kafka-core/partition_assignor.java` and `cluster-manager/controller.py`.

The primary root cause was an unexpected network partition between availability zones `us-east-1a` and `us-east-1b`, causing 24 brokers to trigger leader elections simultaneously across 2,000 partitions. During the cascading election phase, message production halted because `min-insync-replicas` was set to 3 while replica lag exceeded `replica-lag-time-max-ms` of 10,000 milliseconds.

To remediate the cascade, tune ZooKeeper session timeouts from 18 seconds—scratch that, 6 seconds—to 30 seconds, and adjust `group-initial-rebalance-delay-ms` from 3 seconds to 0 seconds for low-latency consumer group handoffs. In addition, update `cluster-manager/controller.py` to ensure that partition state machine transitions throttle concurrent leader reassignments to 50 partitions per second rather than allowing unconstrained batch elections.

Under no circumstances should any engineer set `unclean-leader-election-enable` to `true`, as this could risk catastrophic data loss across financial audit logs. The principal systems architect requires all broker nodes to configure `socket-send-buffer-bytes` and `socket-receive-buffer-bytes` to 1 megabyte each to prevent TCP buffer starvation under high load.

Confirm that consumer applications using the Java client library implement backoff retries with exponential jitter, starting at 200 milliseconds and capped at 5,000 milliseconds. Incident coordinators should also review `docs/runbooks/kafka_rebalance.md` to verify that manual topic partition rebalancing commands specify explicit throttle rates.

The observability team must establish automated Grafana alerts that trigger when the under-replicated partition count exceeds zero for more than three consecutive minutes. Also verify that all broker nodes emit JMX metrics to Datadog, tracking active controller count and offline partition count, with zero-second reporting intervals.

The data platform engineering manager confirmed that all storage volumes must maintain 20 percent free disk space before high-throughput bulk ingestion pipelines resume. Network engineers must inspect edge load balancers to ensure TCP keepalive probes are enabled with an interval of 30 seconds and a probe count of 3. Also verify that consumer group heartbeat threads run on dedicated high-priority CPU cores to avoid false positives during heavy garbage collection pauses.

The billing ingestion pipeline must configure `max-poll-interval-ms` to 300,000 milliseconds to accommodate long-running batch database transactions. Do not execute broker rolling restarts during peak business hours, between 9 a.m. and 6 p.m. Eastern Time, without vice president approval.

All schema registry client libraries must enable local in-memory schema caching with a maximum capacity of 10,000 schemas to minimize HTTP request overhead. Security operations must audit SSL certificate expiration dates across all broker nodes and ensure automated rotation 30 days before expiration.

Site reliability engineers will conduct simulated broker failure drills in staging next Tuesday morning to validate that partition rebalancing completes in under 45 seconds. The backup and disaster recovery team must confirm that MirrorMaker 2 replication lag between primary and secondary cloud regions remains below 2 seconds.

Configure log segment compaction threads with `min-cleanable-dirty-ratio` set to 0.5 to avoid excessive disk I/O during active hours. Client application connection pools must enforce idle connection timeouts of 60 seconds to prune orphaned TCP sockets.

The platform security team requires mutual TLS authentication between all producers and brokers, using certificates issued by our internal Vault PKI. Incident leads must ensure that post-incident action items are tracked in Jira with assigned engineering owners and target completion dates within two sprints.

For the upcoming migration to KRaft consensus architecture, inspect `metadata/kraft.properties`. Confirm that `controller-quorum-voters` lists all five dedicated KRaft controller nodes across independent rack topologies. Verify that the metadata log replication segment size is configured to 64 megabytes and the metadata snapshot interval is set to one hour.

All transactional producer applications must set `enable-idempotence` to `true` and configure `transaction-timeout-ms` to 30,000 milliseconds. In addition, JVM runtime flags on all broker instances must pin the G1 garbage collector, with `max-gc-pause-millis` set to 20 milliseconds and `initiating-heap-occupancy-percent` set to 45 percent, to eliminate stop-the-world latency spikes during active partition movements.

Tiered storage offloading must be enabled for all historical topic partitions older than 48 hours, streaming compressed segments directly to encrypted S3 buckets. The data governance team mandates that topic deletion operations require dual authorization signatures in the cluster administration portal.

Finally, schedule a comprehensive architectural readiness review with the infrastructure director for Friday morning at 10 a.m. to audit all verified configuration diffs and authorize rollout to the production cluster.
